steps.assistant_text: Exact (agent-g run 228, 99.91 -> 100). The last 3 rows were the post-call 0x358 reload in f0 (target f2). The -zdbug:5 colouring dump showed the reload alone in its uopt block with nothing to interfere with, so the fix is a register PREFERENCE: write the reload into fr (fr = f358; cb(0x4D010000, ((f32)i + fr) / fr)), and add an if (fr) {} before the 256-block 0x358 store. That use lifts the 256-block fr web's priority so it colours first (f2), and the reload web of the same variable then takes f2.
